description:
Configure a specialized technical analysis chart in NinjaTrader 8. The application is open on the desktop.

Your goal is to set up a Renko chart for SPY to filter out price noise.

1. Create a new Chart for the instrument 'SPY'.
2. Configure the Data Series to use 'Renko' bars instead of standard Minute/Day bars.
3. Set the Renko 'Brick Size' to 2.
4. Add an 'EMA' (Exponential Moving Average) indicator with a Period of 21 overlaying the price.
5. Add an 'ADX' (Average Directional Index) indicator with a Period of 14 in a new panel.
6. Save the workspace to ensure your configuration is stored.
